title: pinus monophylla var. californiarum
intro: Pinus monophylla var. californiarum, commonly known as California single-leaf pinyon, is a variety of the single-leaf pinyon pine tree, native to the southwestern United States. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional folk medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Pinus monophylla var. californiarum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections, wounds, and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant activities.
